title: MINOR: Remove redundant tools test-common-util dependency
body:
Remove the explicit testImplementation dependency on
:test-common:test-common-util from :tools.

The only compile-time use was the @Flaky annotation, which #23531
removed. The module is still on the test runtime classpath via
runtimeTestLibs, so the JUnit filters keep working.

Follow-up to the cleanup discussed in #23466.

Generated-by: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6)

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

files.patch:
@@ -2719,7 +2719,6 @@ project(':tools') {
     testImplementation testFixtures(project(':server'))
     testImplementation project(':test-common:test-common-internal-api')
     testImplementation project(':test-common:test-common-runtime')
-    testImplementation project(':test-common:test-common-util')
     testImplementation project(':server-common')
     testImplementation testFixtures(project(':server-common'))
     testImplementation project(':connect:api')
